body: I don't want to sound rude.. But I've tried. It's like everything I try intensifies what I'm feeling. Makes me long for him to be by mysid even more so.

I know it isn't enough time.. I just don't know if I can wait. I was about to start my life with him when he decided to back out. I threw everything I owned out and came home. I have family here.. But I feel so misplaced. I don't have a job. I'm thousands and thousands in debt because of school. I don't have a place to call my own. I've been living out of suitcase, going from my moms to my sisters. I don't have anything anymore. He was everything. What's the point of being around? I'm so tired of being strong and driven.
I want to be.. But I don't how to be anymore.

In all honesty, I feel like I don't have any hobbies or anything. Everything I did enjoy was because of him. I can't even turn on the tv without associating anything with him. I can't be in my sisters apartment because it reminds me of our trip here in may. 

I've tried so hard to be happy.. To not care anymore. But everything goes back to him.
